process_area.title: Price Freeze Governance, State of Calamity Controls & Regulatory Reporting

value_stream.name: Disaster Relief Supply Chain Logistics & Humanitarian Aid Coordination

fields.Participants: DTI Liaison, Legal Operations (VS-100), Store Managers
fields.Trigger: National government (NDRRMC) or LGU Council declaring a State of Calamity in store regions

workflows.name: LGU State of Calamity Declaration Trigger & Pricing Monitoring

Automation Opportunity: - Web scraper monitoring LGU/NDRRMC calamity declarations and sending email alerts to pricing team.
Controls: - CTL-771: Declaration log maintained by Legal; affected store list signed off by Compliance Officer.
Cross-references: - links to VS-76 (LGU compliance), VS-01.2 (pricing), VS-100 (legal)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Delayed detection of declaration**: Store continues selling at updated prices, violating law; mitigated by automated alerts from government RSS feeds.
System Touchpoints: - LGU permit tracking system (VS-76), Pricing configuration engine (VS-01.2), Legal database (VS-100).

steps.activity: Monitor official Gazette and NDRRMC releases for State of Calamity declarations.
Identify affected BuildRight store locations within the declared cities, municipalities, or provinces.
Verify the official date and timing of the declaration (which triggers the statutory 60-day price freeze under the Price Act, RA 7581).
Issue formal price freeze notification to the Pricing Team, Store Managers, and the CFO.

fields.Participants: Pricing Analyst, POS Administrator (VS-08), Store Operations (VS-07)

workflows.name: ERP Price Freeze Configuration & Store-Level Price Lock Execution

Automation Opportunity: - System-wide price lock script executed by store group tag.
Controls: - CTL-771 (ensure controlled execution — Price Freeze Governance, State of Calamity Controls & Regulatory Reporting (PA-180.2).)
- CTL-771: Price freeze database verified against pre-calamity transactional prices; audit trail archived.
Cross-references: - links to VS-01.2 (pricing), VS-08 (POS), VS-27 (IT), VS-07 (store ops)
Pain Points / Risks: - **System sync error**: POS terminals fail to receive price locks, selling at higher prices; mitigated by mandatory POS EOD verification checks.
System Touchpoints: - ERP Pricing database (VS-01.2), POS price master (VS-08), WMS pricing lookup.

steps.activity: Retrieve price list for the affected stores: lock selling prices of basic necessities and prime commodities (GI sheets, lumber, cement, nails, electrical wires) to their prevailing prices prior to calamity declaration.
Configure price locks in ERP: disable manual price overrides and promotional discounts for frozen SKUs at the affected store group.
Push price database updates to store POS terminals; verify update confirmation from all affected registers.
Instruct store staff to print and display the price freeze compliance list at store entrance and customer service counters.

fields.Frequency: Weekly during calamity period (up to 60 days)
fields.Participants: Pricing Analyst (VS-01.2), Store Managers, DTI Inspectors
fields.Trigger: DTI request; weekly price monitoring requirements during State of Calamity

workflows.name: Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Price Compliance Reporting

Automation Opportunity: - Automated generation of pricing compliance report sheets from ERP data.
Controls: - CTL-771: Report signed off by LGU Liaison; copy of DTI inspection certificates filed in document control (VS-88).
Cross-references: - links to VS-08 (POS), VS-01.2 (pricing), VS-88 (document control)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Failing DTI audit**: Discrepancies between store price tag and POS database; mitigated by daily store manager price audits.
System Touchpoints: - DTI submission portal, POS transaction database (VS-08), pricing master.

steps.activity: Aggregate price lists: compile actual POS transaction prices for basic commodities sold at affected stores.
Prepare the DTI Price Compliance Report matching actual retail prices to pre-calamity baselines.
File report with the local DTI provincial office and upload to the DTI compliance portal.
Host DTI field inspectors at store sites; provide access to POS registers, inventory ledgers, and price displays.

fields.Trigger: Activation of price locks (W5186); monthly financial close
fields.Volume: Reconciliation of affected store groups (~20–40 stores)

workflows.name: Price Freeze Audit, Margin Impact Analysis & Financial Provisioning

Automation Opportunity: - System calculation of cost-vs-frozen-price margin differences.
Controls: - CTL-771: Provision entries verified by Controller; margin variance reports shared with CFO.
Cross-references: - links to VS-17.1 (GL close), VS-15 (P2P), VS-158 (product costing), VS-01 (merch strategy), VS-18 (treasury), VS-79 (tax)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Gross margin squeeze**: Input costs exceed frozen selling prices, causing net losses; mitigated by vendor price freeze agreements and sourcing adjustments.
System Touchpoints: - ERP GL (VS-17.1), AP ledger (VS-15), Cost accounting database (VS-158).

steps.activity: Calculate margin dilution: compare actual purchase costs (spiking due to emergency shipping) against frozen selling prices.
Analyze purchase price adjustments (PPA): identify vendors increasing costs during freeze period.
Prepare the Margin Impact Report: compute EBITDA dilution and inventory writedowns for affected branches.
Set up financial provisions in the General Ledger (VS-17.1) for expected margin drops.

fields.Participants: Zoning Officer (VS-76), POS Cashiers (VS-08), Store Manager
fields.Trigger: State of Calamity declaration (W5185); DTI advisory on basic necessity limits

Automation Opportunity: - POS automated prompt blocking transaction when quantity exceed limits.
Controls: - CTL-771 (ensure controlled execution — Price Freeze Governance, State of Calamity Controls & Regulatory Reporting (PA-180.2).)
- CTL-771: Manager overrides logged and reviewed weekly by Loss Prevention (VS-23).
Cross-references: - links to VS-08 (POS), VS-27 (IT), VS-76 (LGU compliance), VS-13 (loyalty), VS-23 (loss prevention)
Pain Points / Risks: - **POS bypass / Split transactions**: Customers creating multiple loyalty profiles or cash bills to bypass limits; mitigated by cashier training and POS limit rules based on matching credit cards / phone numbers.
System Touchpoints: - POS configuration module (VS-08), Loyalty customer database (VS-13).

steps.activity: Define quantity limit rules: set maximum allowable purchase quantities per customer for basic necessities (e.g. max 5 sheets of GI roofing, 10 bags of cement, 1 generator).
Configure limits in the POS software: block scanning of quantities above limit in a single transaction/customer profile.
Implement cashier override protocol: require manager PIN authorization (W5122) for legitimate trade-pro or LGU bulk sales.
Display quantity limit advisories at checkout lanes and power aisles.

fields.Participants: City/Municipal Treasurer, Business Permit Licensing Office (BPLO), Tax Manager (VS-79)
fields.Trigger: LGU declaration of State of Calamity

workflows.name: State of Calamity LGU Regulatory Permit Clearance & Fee Deferrals

Controls: - CTL-771: Extension approvals verified by Legal; tax accruals matched to BPLO letters.
Cross-references: - links to VS-76 (LGU compliance), VS-166 (license portfolio), VS-79 (tax)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Late filing penalties**: LGU BPLO miscalculating deferral dates and issuing fines; mitigated by securing written, stamped BPLO extension letters.
System Touchpoints: - License tracking portal (VS-166), LGU portal, ERP tax ledger (VS-79).

steps.activity: Monitor LGU announcements for regulatory tax/fee deferrals and permit extensions.
Apply for extension: submit application to BPLO to defer local business tax renewals and sanitary/environmental fees.
Secure BPLO approval documents; update the centralized license calendar (VS-166) with extended deadlines.
Track deferred liabilities: accrue unpaid local taxes in GL for payment post-calamity.

fields.Participants: Bureau of Customs (BOC), DOF (Dept of Finance), Import team (VS-02.2)
fields.Trigger: National disaster causing massive supply shortfalls; imports of reconstruction materials (lumber, roofing) prioritized

workflows.name: Emergency Import Tariffs/Customs Duty Deferral Application

Controls: - CTL-771 (ensure controlled execution — Price Freeze Governance, State of Calamity Controls & Regulatory Reporting (PA-180.2).)
- CTL-771: BOC Customs Release Order signed by authorized collector; compliance reports filed post-delivery showing material distribution.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Port delays / Demurrage**: Customs officials delaying clearance due to paperwork checks; mitigated by securing pre-clearance approvals from the BOC Commissioner.
System Touchpoints: - BOC e2m portal, customs brokerage system (VS-87), import control tower (W250).

steps.activity: Identify imported cargo (e.g. lumber, steel coil) in transit for disaster relief.
File application for tariff exemption or duty deferral under DOF/BOC emergency disaster relief rules (e.g. RA 10863 / CMTA provisions).
Provide documentation: import manifests, certificates of donation/relief supply, LGU letters, and cargo distribution plans.
Secure BOC Customs Release Order for duty-deferred release; transport cargo directly from port to DC/affected stores.

fields.Participants: External Auditor, Store Manager, Loss Prevention (VS-23), Finance
fields.Trigger: Physical damage to stores or DCs; write-off of ruined inventory

workflows.name: Disaster Tax Relief & BIR Casualty Loss Deduction Certification

Controls: - CTL-771 (ensure controlled execution — Price Freeze Governance, State of Calamity Controls & Regulatory Reporting (PA-180.2).)
- CTL-771: Loss write-off approved by CFO; BIR filing certificate signed by tax agent.
Cross-references: - links to VS-79 (tax), VS-35 (fixed assets), VS-05 (inventory lifecycle), VS-23 (loss prevention)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Loss deduction denied**: BIR rejects claim due to inadequate proof of damage; mitigated by securing notary-certified damage photos and external auditor verified write-off manifests.
System Touchpoints: - ERP Tax module (VS-79), Fixed assets ledger (VS-35), Inventory write-off system (VS-05).

steps.activity: Conduct physical inventory of ruined and damaged stock; take photos and compile police/LP reports (VS-23).
Draft inventory write-off report; post casualty loss adjustments in ERP asset ledger (VS-35).
File formal claim for Casualty Loss Deduction at the BIR Revenue District Office (RDO) within 45 days of disaster.
Secure BIR Commissioner's validation clearance; attach to corporate income tax return to deduct losses from taxable income.
